To Whom It May Concern,  

I have had the pleasure of working with Emilia Korhonen over the past year as her direct manager at NexaCloud Solutions. As a Junior Backend Engineer, she has demonstrated a clear ability to contribute meaningfully to our SaaS product development.  

Emilia’s strength lies in her analytical mindset and ability to translate complex requirements into efficient, scalable solutions. She consistently prioritizes reliability and clarity in her code, which has reduced debugging time for her team by 20% in the modules she’s supported. Her proactive approach to learning has also allowed her to quickly adapt to new challenges, such as optimizing a critical API endpoint that saw a 35% improvement in response latency after her adjustments.  

One notable example occurred during a project requiring real-time data synchronization across multiple services. Emilia independently researched and implemented a lightweight middleware solution, which resolved a recurring integration issue without significant resource overhead. Her ability to balance technical rigor with practical constraints was evident in the seamless deployment of this fix. Beyond her technical skills, she consistently collaborates openly with cross-functional teams, ensuring her work aligns with broader product goals.  

Emilia’s reliability and curiosity make her a valuable asset. She approaches problems with methodical precision and a willingness to iterate based on feedback. I am confident she will excel in any role that demands both technical acumen and collaborative problem-solving.
